enemy.name: Hollow Scarecrow
enemy.description: A stolen scarecrow packed with grave straw, crow bones, and bitter field magic. It shambles toward warmth and tries to make farms feel abandoned.
enemy.defeat_text: The scarecrow collapses into ordinary straw, and the field immediately seems less lonely.

enemy.name: Starved Field Rat
enemy.description: A dog-sized rat driven mad by famine magic, its fur full of seed husks and burial dust.
enemy.defeat_text: The rat flees into the grass, leaving only gnawed seed shells behind.

enemy.name: Grain-Mite Swarm
enemy.description: A living brown cloud of biting mites that strips grain sacks bare and turns pantries into dust.
enemy.defeat_text: The swarm scatters like spilled pepper, and the air stops tasting of husks.

enemy.name: Burrow Gnawer
enemy.description: A squat tunneling beast with shovel claws and a jaw strong enough to chew through roots, fences, and cellar doors.
enemy.defeat_text: The gnawer curls into the loam, and its tunnel stops widening.

enemy.name: Rotroot Blight
enemy.description: A crawling knot of diseased rootlets animated by spiteful druidry and old grave damp.
enemy.defeat_text: The blight dries into harmless mulch, and nearby roots uncurl.

enemy.name: Miser-Wight
enemy.description: A pale, ledger-clutching dead thing from the age of tithe barns, obsessed with counting what others need.
enemy.defeat_text: The wight’s ledger burns from the inside, releasing the names it tried to own.

enemy.name: Dire Burrower
enemy.description: A huge badger-mole twisted by barrow magic, strong enough to undermine roads and smart enough to avoid honest traps.
enemy.defeat_text: The dire burrower crashes down in a spray of loam, opening a clearer way to the tunnels below.

enemy.name: Fallowmaw, the Unsharing Lord
enemy.description: A famine-wight bound to the memory of the old baron who once tried to own every oven, seed, and hunger in Greenbarrow. He is the antithesis of Applewallow: hoarding instead of sharing, rule instead of neighbor-law, isolation instead of community.
enemy.defeat_text: Fallowmaw’s hoarded seed spills across the floor. The grains glow, divide, and become enough for many hands.

enemy.name: Cabal Scree Raider
enemy.description: A masked raider trained to cut wagon traces, scatter oxen, and vanish into red stone before roadwardens arrive.
enemy.defeat_text: The raider slides down the scree, leaving stolen route chalk and a badly forged Vandarom token behind.

enemy.name: Master Veskar Blackvein
enemy.description: A powerful Crownless Cabal necromancer in cracked sun-iron mail. Veskar uses the remains of dwarven miners as obedient labor, intending to enslave the living dwarves and make weapons only for the Crownless Cabal.
enemy.defeat_text: Veskar's command bell splits, the dead miners lower their tools, and the command vault fills with the sound of chains falling apart.

enemy.name: Red Scree Ambusher
enemy.description: A hill raider who fights from above with hook-lines, weighted nets, and stolen dwarf road flares.
enemy.defeat_text: The ambusher tumbles from the high scree, and the road below grows briefly safer.

enemy.name: Bone-Pick Miner
enemy.description: The animated remains of a miner, still carrying a pick, still obeying bell commands it hated in life.
enemy.defeat_text: The bone-pick falls, and for a breath the mine sounds like mourning instead of labor.

enemy.name: Cabal Chaincaller
enemy.description: A necromantic overseer who rings a black handbell to make dead miners lift, march, and strike.
enemy.defeat_text: The chaincaller's bell cracks, and nearby bones forget the rhythm of obedience.

enemy.name: Carrion Bat Swarm
enemy.description: A shrieking cloud of pale bats drawn to old blood, lamp heat, and fresh mistakes.
enemy.defeat_text: The swarm breaks apart into the rafters, leaving the tunnel echoes less frantic.

enemy.name: Dead Miner Thrall
enemy.description: A miner's body forced upright by Cabal magic, its hands still bearing calluses from honest work.
enemy.defeat_text: The thrall drops its tool and lies still enough to be mourned.

enemy.name: Sun-Iron Ghoul
enemy.description: An undead feeder with sun-iron filings fused into its teeth, leaving cold burns instead of ordinary wounds.
enemy.defeat_text: The ghoul's teeth dim like quenched metal, and the air loses a measure of grave-cold.

enemy.name: Pit Scarab Swarm
enemy.description: Iron-backed scarabs nesting beneath old pitfall debris, hungry for leather straps, lamp oil, and soft ankles.
enemy.defeat_text: The scarabs scatter into cracks, leaving only clicking echoes under the stone.

enemy.name: Bone-Rail Sentinel
enemy.description: A tall sentinel assembled from tram parts, femurs, brake wheels, and bound miner oaths.
enemy.defeat_text: The sentinel folds into scrap, and the bone-rail tram shudders out of its cursed loop.

enemy.name: Cabal Taskmaster
enemy.description: A brutal overseer carrying chain diagrams, punishment rods, and production quotas for enslaved smiths.
enemy.defeat_text: The taskmaster drops the quota rod, and the unfinished chain pens become merely iron again.

enemy.name: Briar-Pact Wisp
enemy.description: A green-white wisp born from an oath broken in secret. It burns brighter when someone nearby lies.
enemy.defeat_text: The wisp unravels into ribbon-smoke and the broken oath falls silent.

enemy.name: Moon-Mote Swarm
enemy.description: A swarm of star-bright moths that bite memory from exposed skin and carry it back to moonlit nests.
enemy.defeat_text: The moon-motes scatter, leaving pale dust and the uncomfortable feeling that you almost forgot your own birthday.

enemy.name: Thornbound Hound
enemy.description: A hunting beast grown from briar, bone, and loyal rage, traditionally used by the Court to chase oathbreakers.
enemy.defeat_text: The hound collapses into sticks and one last loyal whine.

enemy.name: Petal-Masked Duelist
enemy.description: A masked Fey duelist enthralled by the Oracle’s promise that revenge can be elegant.
enemy.defeat_text: The mask falls away, and the duelist remembers shame before vanishing into petals.

enemy.name: Orrery Gear-Spirit
enemy.description: A celestial maintenance spirit gone feral after centuries of calculating a disaster no one came to prevent.
enemy.defeat_text: The gear-spirit slows, clicks once in gratitude or accusation, and dims.

enemy.name: Name-Eaten Pilgrim
enemy.description: A traveler whose name was taken by the Oracle’s curse, leaving only hunger for identities still intact.
enemy.defeat_text: The pilgrim exhales a stolen syllable and becomes only a body at rest.

enemy.name: Grotto Echo
enemy.description: A violent echo of testimony, repeating old pain until it becomes a weapon.
enemy.defeat_text: The echo breaks apart into overlapping whispers, then one clean silence.

enemy.name: Oracle’s Revenge-Sprite
enemy.description: A sprite twisted into a living curse by the Oracle, carrying needles made from the Court’s unpaid debts.
enemy.defeat_text: The sprite drops its debt-needles and looks briefly like a child before fading.

enemy.name: The Nameless Oracle
enemy.description: Once Onfadell’s truth-speaker, the Nameless Oracle was stripped of her name by the Court and now seeks revenge on all Fey folk, guilty and innocent alike. Her magic steals names, titles, and futures to feed a curse against the city that betrayed her.
enemy.defeat_text: The Oracle’s voice breaks into a thousand returned names. Whether she dies, yields, or is bound by judgment, the pool releases the Crownroot Thorn Sigil.

enemy.name: Mire Leech Swarm
enemy.description: A boiling mass of thumb-thick leeches that climbs reeds and armor whenever warm blood passes.
enemy.defeat_text: The swarm drops back into the mud, leaving the water briefly clear.

enemy.name: Reedbone Blight
enemy.description: A bundle of reeds, exposed ribs, and swamp rot animated by a spiteful remnant of the lost kingdom.
enemy.defeat_text: Its reed ribs snap one by one, and the blight sinks like rotten thatch.

enemy.name: Blackwater Crocodile
enemy.description: A vast crocodile with old arrowheads embedded in its hide and a patient hatred of splashing feet.
enemy.defeat_text: The crocodile vanishes beneath red-black ripples and does not surface again.

enemy.name: Drowned Soldier of the Lost King
enemy.description: A rust-armored corpse still marching under waterlogged orders from a kingdom no one living remembers.
enemy.defeat_text: The soldier salutes something behind you, then collapses into a heap of silted mail.

enemy.name: Crown-Silt Slime
enemy.description: A translucent ooze glittering with flecks of royal seal-wax, bone meal, and old astral metal.
enemy.defeat_text: The slime loses cohesion and drains through cracks in the stone.

enemy.name: Oathless Shield-Ghoul
enemy.description: A former keep guard whose shield arm has fused to a barnacled tower shield. It blocks doors for a captain long dead.
enemy.defeat_text: The ghoul drops its shield, and the room seems wider without its old refusal.

enemy.name: Vault Wight-Squire
enemy.description: A lesser undead knight polished by floodwater and bound to serve the captain’s final command.
enemy.defeat_text: The wight-squire kneels as if dismissed at last, then breaks into drifting ash.

enemy.name: Captain Ildran Veyr, Crown-Drowned Wight
enemy.description: The undead knight-captain of the lost kingdom stands waist-deep in black water, his drowned oath wrapped around the Astral Crown band like a chain. He believes all heirs, fey, lizardfolk, and living kingdoms betrayed his monarch.
enemy.defeat_text: Captain Ildran’s armor splits along seams of star-silver. His final salute becomes release rather than command, and the Drowned Band of the Astral Crown loosens from the drowned oath.

enemy.name: Saltglass Jackal
enemy.description: A lean desert pack-beast with glassy spines along its back and a talent for attacking from heat-haze.
enemy.defeat_text: Saltglass Jackal falls, and the heat-haze around it steadies into ordinary desert light.

enemy.name: Highway Raid-Sabre
enemy.description: A masked raider who has learned to strike caravans when mirage towers briefly blind the road.
enemy.defeat_text: Highway Raid-Sabre falls, and the heat-haze around it steadies into ordinary desert light.

enemy.name: Mirror-Bandit Arcanist
enemy.description: A renegade spell-thief carrying copied Blue Veil diagrams and just enough talent to misuse them.
enemy.defeat_text: Mirror-Bandit Arcanist falls, and the heat-haze around it steadies into ordinary desert light.

enemy.name: Veilglass Basilisk
enemy.description: A squat reptilian predator whose transparent crest flashes with petrifying afterimages.
enemy.defeat_text: Veilglass Basilisk falls, and the heat-haze around it steadies into ordinary desert light.

enemy.name: Tower Lens-Golem
enemy.description: A wheeled guardian frame of brass, sunstone, and lens arrays, still obeying obsolete tower commands.
enemy.defeat_text: Tower Lens-Golem falls, and the heat-haze around it steadies into ordinary desert light.

enemy.name: Mirage Revenant
enemy.description: The thirsty ghost of a traveler who followed the wrong horizon until the desert learned his name.
enemy.defeat_text: Mirage Revenant falls, and the heat-haze around it steadies into ordinary desert light.

enemy.name: Null-Mage Binder
enemy.description: A Crownless Cabal field mage testing anti-will collars meant for captured Blue Veil spellwrights.
enemy.defeat_text: Null-Mage Binder falls, and the heat-haze around it steadies into ordinary desert light.

enemy.name: Silent Glass Sentinel
enemy.description: An unseen dungeon guardian whose outline becomes visible only when dust strikes it.
enemy.defeat_text: Silent Glass Sentinel falls, and the heat-haze around it steadies into ordinary desert light.

enemy.name: Prism Shade
enemy.description: A refracted undead thing split into several almost-bodies, each one late to the same killing motion.
enemy.defeat_text: Prism Shade falls, and the heat-haze around it steadies into ordinary desert light.

enemy.name: The Glass Wyrm
enemy.description: A vast translucent wyrm that nested inside invisible architecture and fed on wasted spellwork, flawed research, and secrets no faction could safely keep.
enemy.defeat_text: The Glass Wyrm falls, and the heat-haze around it steadies into ordinary desert light.

enemy.name: Kobold Sail-Stalker
enemy.description: A lean kobold raider wrapped in tarred sailcloth, trained to strike from reeds and vanish under raft covers.
enemy.defeat_text: The sail-stalker drops its hooked knife and disappears beneath its own wet cloak.

enemy.name: Human Privateer Duelist
enemy.description: A bonded privateer turned pirate, wearing stolen League blue over a duelist’s harness and a smile full of bad contract law.
enemy.defeat_text: The duelist falls with one hand still reaching for a forged warrant.

enemy.name: Powder-Keg Kobold
enemy.description: A soot-blackened kobold sapper carrying too many fuses and laughing whenever someone says “careful.”
enemy.defeat_text: The kobold’s last fuse hisses out harmlessly in a puddle.

enemy.name: Kobold Raftcaller
enemy.description: A reed-masked kobold caller who coordinates raft ambushes with shell whistles and insulting hand gestures.
enemy.defeat_text: The raftcaller’s whistle cracks, scattering the remaining rafts.

enemy.name: Privateer Signal-Spotter
enemy.description: A human shore agent using signal flags and hooded lanterns to guide pirate fire toward supply stores.
enemy.defeat_text: The spotter’s lantern shatters, sending the bombardment line into confusion.

enemy.name: Privateer Boarding Captain
enemy.description: A ruthless human captain with a serrated boarding saber and an officer’s coat cut from three stolen uniforms.
enemy.defeat_text: The boarding captain collapses under the weight of unpaid crimes and wet velvet.

enemy.name: Reef-Drowned Ghoul
enemy.description: A drowned corpse packed with reef coral and old hunger, clawing at living warmth from beneath tidewater.
enemy.defeat_text: The ghoul breaks apart into coral, rags, and one final rush of trapped bubbles.

enemy.name: Reef Ogre Deckbreaker
enemy.description: A barnacled ogre hired by the pirate fleet to smash decks, gates, and anyone who objects to smashing.
enemy.defeat_text: The deckbreaker hits the ground like a capsizing boat.

enemy.name: Labyrinth Scorpion Swarm
enemy.description: Dozens of translucent scorpions pour from cracks in the buried stone, each one glowing with trap-magic.
enemy.defeat_text: The swarm scatters into the walls, leaving only twitching glassy tails.

enemy.name: Serpent-Tile Construct
enemy.description: A knot of animated green-black tiles rises into a serpent shape, enforcing the labyrinth’s old rules without mercy or explanation.
enemy.defeat_text: The construct collapses into ordinary tile, and the floor forgets one of its lies.

enemy.name: Maze-Drowned Guardian
enemy.description: A salt-preserved guardian in corroded armor, still patrolling paths that were meant to confuse the unworthy.
enemy.defeat_text: The guardian kneels, salutes the Tidecrown, and sinks into harmless water.

enemy.name: Eshdru, the Tide-Eyed Serpent
enemy.description: An ancient sea-serpent appointed to guard the Tidecrown Pearl until a worthy bearer reaches the sanctum through wit, restraint, and courage rather than plunder.
enemy.defeat_text: Eshdru lowers its crowned head, not slain so much as satisfied, and allows the Tidecrown Pearl to pass into mortal hands.

enemy.name: Cabal Stormcut Raider
enemy.description: A Crownless Cabal raider wrapped in copper grounding wire and stolen shepherd rope, trained to sabotage bridges and vanish into bad weather.
enemy.defeat_text: The raider falls with a crackle of dying blue sparks, leaving behind stolen climbing marks and a Cabal weather tally.

enemy.name: Skyclaw Rocling
enemy.description: A young roc driven down from higher nests by unnatural storm pressure. It attacks anything carrying metal above shoulder height.
enemy.defeat_text: The rocling shrieks away into the clouds, leaving the path clear and several feathers embedded in stone.

enemy.name: Storm-Crazed Ram
enemy.description: A mountain ram swollen with storm magic, its horns glowing like heated wire before every charge.
enemy.defeat_text: The ram collapses, and the nearby herd stops battering the fence line.

enemy.name: Cabal Storm Sapper
enemy.description: A sapper carrying sky-iron clamps, black wax, and a handbook on how to make old weather engines fail violently.
enemy.defeat_text: The sapper drops a pack of stolen components and stops smiling at the thunder.

enemy.name: Corpse-Lightning Thrall
enemy.description: A dead miner or climber animated by blue corpse-lightning, still gripping the tool or rope it died with.
enemy.defeat_text: The corpse-lightning gutters out, and the body finally falls with the ordinary weight of the dead.

enemy.name: Rune-Scarred Thunder Sentry
enemy.description: A giant-made sentry construct covered in old protective runes and fresh Cabal scars that make it misread allies as intruders.
enemy.defeat_text: The sentry kneels, its corrupted runes burning away to reveal older words for shelter and restraint.

enemy.name: Bone-Gantry Miners
enemy.description: A gang of dwarven miner skeletons wired together with stolen bridge cable and forced to work the thunderforge after death.
enemy.defeat_text: The miners collapse in a chain of snapping wires. Their tools stop striking sparks from bone.

enemy.name: Bound Storm Spirit
enemy.description: A storm spirit imprisoned in salt, ash, and giant hair, lashing out because pain has replaced direction.
enemy.defeat_text: The spirit bursts into clean rain and a thunderclap that sounds almost like thanks.

enemy.name: Stormforge Abomination
enemy.description: A mass of bone, bridge cable, copper coil, and trapped weather, assembled by Vael Tormak as proof that the living are inefficient.
enemy.defeat_text: The abomination breaks apart into rain, bone, and useless wire. The forge shakes as if relieved.

enemy.name: Vael Tormak, the Corpse-Lightning Binder
enemy.description: A Crownless Cabal Stormbinder who has twisted the Hollow Thunderforge into a necromantic storm engine. He conducts dead miners and bound storm spirits to enslave the peaks and forge weather into weapons for the Crownless Cabal.
enemy.defeat_text: Vael Tormak’s conducting rod snaps. The corpse-lightning collapses inward, the dead miners fall still, and the storm giant forge begins to breathe clean thunder again.

enemy.name: Blindstone Stalker
enemy.description: A pale, eyeless cavern predator that listens through its feet and lunges at torch-breath.
enemy.defeat_text: The stalker folds into the stone, finally still.

enemy.name: Glowcap Spore Thrall
enemy.description: A traveler overtaken by hostile spores, moving with borrowed purpose and a mouth full of warning dust.
enemy.defeat_text: The spore cloud settles into harmless gray dust.

enemy.name: Duergar Chain-Taker
enemy.description: A slaver from a deeper tyrant-hold, hunting refugees and selling maps to the Cabal.
enemy.defeat_text: The chain-taker drops his irons and spits one last curse into the floor.

enemy.name: Cabal Bone-Lamplighter
enemy.description: A Crownless Cabal ritualist who hangs witchlight inside skulls and uses the dead as lantern fuel.
enemy.defeat_text: The skull-lamps wink out one by one.

enemy.name: Wyrmglass Skitterer
enemy.description: A glassy many-legged thing that grew around a flake of dragon-shadow and clicks like breaking mirrors.
enemy.defeat_text: The skitterer cracks apart into black splinters.

enemy.name: Echo Wraith
enemy.description: A dead voice wearing the shape of a body, drawn to noisy armor and careless prayers.
enemy.defeat_text: The wraith becomes only a fading echo with no speaker.

enemy.name: Blackscale Drake
enemy.description: A lesser shadow-drake that nests near the Umbralwyrm’s fossil breath and treats warm-blooded creatures as trespassers.
enemy.defeat_text: The drake’s scales dull from black glass to cold stone.

enemy.name: Ossuary Giant
enemy.description: A bone-and-crystal construct assembled from cave-beast remains and giant ribs stolen from old burial shafts.
enemy.defeat_text: The ossuary giant collapses into a heap of quiet bones.

enemy.name: Shadow-Chained Dead
enemy.description: Dead explorers and Compact oathbreakers chained to their own shadows by Cabal glyphs.
enemy.defeat_text: The chains loosen, and the dead finally lie down.

enemy.name: Umbralwyrm’s Breath
enemy.description: A living hazard of draconic shadow given teeth, wings, and a hatred of open flame.
enemy.defeat_text: The breath-shape tears apart like smoke caught in a bellows.

enemy.name: Sister Nhalira Voss, Wyrmchain Necromancer
enemy.description: A Crownless Cabal binder-priestess who plans to make the Umbralwyrm into a living siege engine for the final war.
enemy.defeat_text: Nhalira’s chain-glyphs snap loose, and the ossuary exhales decades of stolen fear.

enemy.name: Vorgul Nethra, the Umbralwyrm
enemy.description: An ancient shadow wyrm whose sleeping body has bent the lower caverns into a living country of darkness, memory, and mineralized fear. The Cabal chains around its shadow are new; its anger is older than the Marches.
enemy.defeat_text: The cavern does not cheer. It simply remembers that you survived a conversation with a dragon.

boss_encounter.intro: The Umbralwyrm coils around the Nightscale Lantern and lowers its head until its eyes are two eclipses. The chains are broken enough for choice, not enough for safety.
boss_encounter.fight: You reject bargain and binding alike. Steel, spell, and courage answer the dragon directly.
boss_encounter.bypass: You lift the Ossuary Sun-Mote, speak the Compact’s debt-law, and sever the last false chain. Vorgul Nethra withdraws into the deep and leaves the Nightscale Lantern as payment, warning, and future debt.

control.label: Bind the wyrm with the Blackflame Shutter

boss_encounter.control: The Blackflame Shutter folds around the dragon’s shadow. Vorgul Nethra obeys for now, but the Compact will remember that you chose control over trust.

delay.label: Collapse the ossuary echoes
delay.success_text: You trigger a fall of rib-stone and echo-crystal, seize the Lantern, and escape before the Umbralwyrm can coil around the chamber again.
delay.failure_text: The echoes return your footfalls in the wrong order. The trap fails, and standard combat begins.

enemy.name: Cabal Crown-Soldier
enemy.description: A black-armored infantry veteran whose helm bears a crown with no brow beneath it.
enemy.defeat_text: The Crown-Soldier drops with a clatter of unliving discipline.

enemy.name: Crownless Death-Adept
enemy.description: A necromantic caster who treats every living prisoner as future architecture.
enemy.defeat_text: The death-adept’s bone abacus spills across the floor and stops counting.

enemy.name: Astral Chainbinder
enemy.description: A Cabal controller who casts chains through space before the shackle appears.
enemy.defeat_text: The chainbinder’s last command folds back around its own throat.

enemy.name: Relic-Scavenged Wight
enemy.description: A grave-knight patched with stolen relic dust from a dozen conquered roads.
enemy.defeat_text: The wight falls apart, and the stolen relic dust no longer knows whose oath to obey.

enemy.name: Dead-Star Harrier
enemy.description: A fast planar assassin that enters rooms through shadows cast by stars that are not there.
enemy.defeat_text: The harrier tears into sparks and wrong constellations.

enemy.name: Cabal Siege Golem
enemy.description: A construct of prison doors, giant rivets, dwarf-forged plates, and screaming seal-stone.
enemy.defeat_text: The siege golem collapses into usable metal and one last muffled scream.

enemy.name: Uncrowned Knight
enemy.description: A fallen champion who kneels to no king because the Lich convinced him obedience is freedom.
enemy.defeat_text: The Uncrowned Knight dies standing, still refusing the wrong lesson.

enemy.name: Name-Flayed Oracle
enemy.description: A captured seer whose true name was stripped away and replaced with Cabal prophecy.
enemy.defeat_text: The oracle exhales one real name before dissolving into silver ash.

enemy.name: Crownless Choir Dead
enemy.description: A chorus of animated prisoners forced to sing the Lich’s coronation before it exists.
enemy.defeat_text: The choir falls silent one throat at a time, and the room remembers mercy.

enemy.name: Planar Seal Horror
enemy.description: A living tear in the seal, grown teeth and hunger where reality tried to stitch itself closed.
enemy.defeat_text: The horror shrinks to a line, then a point, then a sound you cannot keep remembering.

enemy.name: Warden of Broken Chains
enemy.description: The Cabal officer assigned to recapturing the Refuge, wearing manacles as medals.
enemy.defeat_text: The warden dies under the broken-chain banner, and the Refuge gets one full breath without attack.

enemy.name: Dead-Star Marshal
enemy.description: A high Cabal commander who coordinates the Citadel’s materialization through dead-star geometry.
enemy.defeat_text: The marshal’s star-map burns from the inside, leaving only true north and a path forward.

enemy.name: Azael Veyrath, the Crownless Lich
enemy.description: The architect of the Crownless Cabal, an undead tyrant who seeks dominion without responsibility, memory without grief, and order without living consent.
enemy.defeat_text: Azael Veyrath breaks like a crown with no head beneath it. The Citadel waits for the living to decide what power means now.

boss_encounter.intro: The Crownless Lich rises before the incomplete Astral Crown. Around him, every relic you carried becomes witness, accusation, and possible weapon.
boss_encounter.fight: You refuse every throne built from stolen breath. The final battle begins.
boss_encounter.bypass: The relics answer as communities rather than keys. Oath, craft, tide, storm, memory, and shadow reject the Lich at once, and the throne begins sealing around him.
boss_encounter.control: You raise the Crown-Rite Sigil and force the Lich to kneel beneath the unfinished Astral Crown. The victory is real; so is the warning it leaves in your hands.

delay.label: Shatter the Throne Supports
delay.success_text: You break the throne supports and seize the crown moment as the chamber collapses. Veyrath is not destroyed cleanly, but the Citadel loses its anchor.
delay.failure_text: The throne drinks the impact. The Lich smiles, and standard combat begins.
